;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Estonian parliamentary election]]
**[[Jüri Ratas]], incumbent [[Prime Minister of Estonia]], and his party gets second place in the election, while opposition leader [[Kaja Kallas]]'s [[Estonian Reform Party]] gets the largest number of votes, and the right-wing [[Conservative People's Party of Estonia|Conservative People's Party]] doubles in seats. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/mar/03/estonia-election-centrist-parties-far-right (BBC News)]
*[[2019 Democratic Party (Italy) leadership election|2019 Italian Democratic Party leadership election]]
**Governor of [[Lazio]], [[Nicola Zingaretti]], wins the leadership election by a landslide, defeating [[Maurizio Martina]] and [[Roberto Giachetti]], and becoming the new [[List of Secretaries of the Democratic Party (Italy)|Secretary]] of the [[Democratic Party (Italy)|Democratic Party]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/mar/03/italy-heads-to-the-polls-to-elect-new-leader-for-democratic-party (''The Guardian'')]
*[[National Emergency Concerning the Southern Border of the United States]]
**Senator [[Rand Paul]] is expected to vote against [[Donald Trump]]’s national emergency. [https://thehill.com/homenews/administration/432378-rand-paul-to-vote-against-trumps-national-emergency-declaration?amp (''The Hill'')]

;Science and technology
*[[2019 in spaceflight]]
**[[SpaceX]]'s unmanned spacecraft [[Dragon 2]] successfully docks with the [[International Space Station]] (ISS) for the first time. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-47430432 (BBC News)] [https://www.nasaspaceflight.com/2019/03/crew-dragon-first-docking-iss-dm1/ (NASA Spaceflight)]

;Sports
*[[2019 in tennis]], [[2019 Roger Federer tennis season]], [[Open Era tennis records – men's singles#All tournaments|Open Era tennis records – men's singles]]
**[[Roger Federer]] wins the [[2019 Dubai Tennis Championships]], his 100th [[Association of Tennis Professionals|ATP]] singles title overall, defeating [[Stefanos Tsitsipas]], 6–4, 6–4, in [[2019 Dubai Tennis Championships – Men's Singles#Finals|the final]]. Federer became the second male tennis player in the [[History of tennis#Open Era|Open Era]] after [[Jimmy Connors]] to win 100 ATP singles titles. [https://www.atptour.com/en/news/federer-100-titles-dubai-2019 (ATP Tour)]
